Amazon's early fall Prime Day deals are in full swing, with thousands of items already discounted. While more Apple deals are expected next week, we've already spotted AirTag 2 hitting a new all-time low, $500 off this M5 Pro MacBook Pro, up to $150 off multiple MacBook Air models, plus discounts on some of Apple's newest products.

Those deals are on top of up to $1,200 off smart TVs, a massive selection of MagSafe chargers and external batteries, Amazon smart speakers and displays, smart home upgrades, and more at up to 50% off. Keep scrolling for all the details, and stay tuned — we'll be updating this story all the way through next week.
